notes.title: Add Desktop Widget Mode
notes.notes:
[h1] Now you can put your figures  on your desktop [/h1]

Click on "Desktop Widget" on the left side of the main UI to enter

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/dk/dk1.jpg [/img]

You can place your work on desktop from the 'Figure Warehouse' panel.

The left, right, and middle mouse buttons can be used to move, zoom, and rotate the model.

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/dk/dk2.jpg [/img]

The trayicon  can hide the UI and provide Suspend mode.

After completing the placement, click on the Suspend mode and the program will enter the background without any consumption of GPU and CPU.

Double click on the tray icon or click on options from the tray menu to return to normal mode.

Better effect when used with live wallpaper : Steamhappy :



Future version update plan [/h1]
[list]
[*] Non-humanoid model support, such as tanks, firearms
[/list]
[list]
[*] Model formats such as FBX OBJ support
[/list]

notes.title: Added support for VPD pose files and optimized POSE creation steps
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Added support for VPD pose files and optimized POSE creation steps[/b][/h1]
[img]https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ps/ac1.jpg[/img]
The Pose creation step has been adjusted. In addition to the default 10 original POSEs, POSEs can be created by importing a vpd file,or using the original motion capture method.
[img]https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ps/ac2.jpg[/img]
(The original 'Motion' button has been adjusted to 'POSE' ->'Create' ->'VMD Capture')
The saved POSE can be reused for other model.

[h1][b]Add expression preset[/b][/h1]
[img]https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ps/ac3.jpg[/img]
There are three eye expression presets (the second and third are only applicable to some MMD models),and three mouth shape presets , which allow you to set commonly used expressions with one click.

Fixed a bug where the actual effect did not match the expression settings.

notes.title: Add live wallpaper mode
notes.notes:
[h1] [b] Live desktop mode [/b] [/h1]

The entrance is on the left side with the "Live Wallpaper" button

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ab/ab0.jpg [/img]

[list]

[*] Desktop expansion mode

[/list]

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ab/ab22.gif [/img]

You can zoom the desktop to a virtual scene and then decorate your room with figures.

Can be switched at any time through the tray icon

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ab/ab21.jpg [/img]

The desktop will also refresh in real-time in virtual scenes, whether you are currently watching movie or playing games.



[list]

[*] Wallpaper mode

[/list]

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ab/ab11.jpg [/img]

This mode is a live wallpaper embedded in the desktop, Imitating the holographic figure of the cyberpunk era.

Click on the figure to switch to "Dance" mode, and MMD animation can be played on the desktop.

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/fg/ab/ab1.jpg [/img]

notes.title: New feature:Desktop mode/Output transparent background screenshot
notes.notes:
[h1] [b] Desktop mode [/b] [/h1]



Click the button in the order shown  to enter/exit

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/ac1.jpg [/img]

Move the figure with the middle mouse button, right click to bring it closer, and left click to drag the base to rotate.

Quickly drag and release the left mouse button to trigger rapid rotation, click on the base again to stop, and if the speed is fast enough, it will trigger real physics engine feedback. : steamhappy :

[previewyoutube=Xcb7borRtPU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h1] [b] Output a transparent background PNG screenshot of a single figure [/b] [/h1]

Click the button in the order shown  to capture the transparent screenshot of the currently selected figure 

[img] https://medicine-1257469607.file.myqcloud.com/other/ac2.jpg [/img]
